Name: Spacecore Luck Skill
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
[size=3]This mod is a port of the Luck skill into the SpaceCore API system, rather than how the original luck skill did it. This makes the skill more compatible with other skill mods, prestige mods, and more. I did tweak a lot of tiny values and names from the previous version, to try to make it more of a "complete" skill. Like there are now icons for professions.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3qxSqCb.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=3]Gain EXP based off Daily luck levels, finding geods, and finding treasure chests[/size]
[*][size=3]Higher luck levels affect stuff like....  finding ladders on floors when mining, finding geods, duck feathers,  ect[/size]
[*][size=3]Adds new slot machines, unlocked as you level up your luck skill! Exchange excess metal bars for other resources at these machines. Results may very. [/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LGFY8Nd.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=3]Level up Bonus: Higher chance for good events, night events, ect.[/size]
[/list][size=3][list]
[*]Level 5a: Gambler - Better daily luck.[list]
[*]Level 10a1: Lucky - 20% chance for daily luck to just be maxed.
[*]Level 10a2: Fortune Teller - Never have bad daily luck (if daily luck is below 0, will set it to 0).
[/list]
[*]Level 5b: Assistant - Daily quests occur three times as often
[list]
[*]Level 10b1: Shooting Star - Night events happen twice as often
[*]Level 10b2: Spirit Child - Giving gifts make junimos happy, they might help your farm (Chance for plants to grow or animals to produce when giving a gift to others)
[/list][/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2tjtjDL.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Daily luck Exp bonus: how much luck exp is gained passively. Can turn this to zero to turn off passive exp gain from luck
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg7jJbF.png[/img]
[list]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/174]All Professions[/url]: All spacecore skills are already compatible with all professions.﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]﻿: Has built in support for better crafting through the API!
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿: With the switch to content patcher, all items should correctly show up with the item patcher.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kR18mAK.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Having a luck skill buff won't show up on the skill menu. This is due to how this skill works. It keeps track of your spacecore luck skill and sets the CA luck skill to equal it every 10 minutes. ﻿
[/list]
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/NaNmbIk.png[/img]
[list]
[*]You can find the [url=https://github.com/Pet-Slime/StardewValley/tree/master/CookingSkillRedux]github here[/url]﻿﻿ to open pull requests
[*]If you want to help out with making the skill better, please do! I will accept most pull requests if you want to help with like optimizing the code, translations, or bug fixes.
[/list]
[/size] [i][size=5][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/SkgptFd.png[/img][/size][/size][/i][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the LuckSkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installed on an existing file, the new professions should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PYiimss.png[/img]
[size=3]Special thanks to: The stardew valley discord, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url], DrBird.  And finally WIZ from the stardew discord for speed bug testing.
